description: Use this when the user asks who changed something in the account and when: who paused a site, who invited someone, what an AI agent did. Returns entries newest first with the time, the member, the action, what it changed and, for changes made through an AI agent, which one (via). Owners and admins only. Not for monitoring history or incidents: use get_monitor_history or list_incidents.

action.description: Only this action, as entries name it (for example monitor.pause or invitation.create).

from.description: Only entries on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

member.description: Only changes made by this member, by email address.

page.description: Page of results, 25 a page. Default 1.

text.description: Words to find in the entry: a site or member name, an email address, an action such as "paused".

to.description: Only entries on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: search_audit_log
title: Search the audit log
